newsitem.title: USA: Environment One sees rev, earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Environment One sees rev, earnings growth.

text.p: Environment One Corp said Thursday it expects to post 10 percent growth in revenues in the second quarter.
For the full year, it expects to post 20 percent growth in revenues in 1997 and an estimated 40 percent increase in earnings, the company said.
The company reported first quarter results Thursday, showing net income from operations of $144,944, or $0.03 per share, on revenue of $4.55 million.
In the prior year's first quarter, the company reported net income from operations of $79,489, or $0.02 per share, on revenues of $3.95 million.

"We are emerging from the winter quarter in good position to make 1997 another championship year, where, in spite of harsh weather slowing projects, we have grown earnings," Chairman, President and Chief Executive Stephen Ardia said in a statement.
"A strong showing by our detection systems business along with a more powerful E/ONE sewer systems distribution network bodes well for continued growth."
Environment One manufactures and provides products and services for the disposal of residential sanitary waste, and detection systems to protect high value electric utility equipment.
